name: Mirror Slideshow
description: Full-screen slideshow where each image is mirrored down its center to form a symmetrical figure, with a large colored title behind and a text navigation. Images slide in and out with GSAP.
contents: Full-screen slides, each with a mirrored image pair and a large colored title
Small uppercase heading above the titles
Text navigation buttons, one per slide
behavior: Images slide in from the side or bottom with a tilt and ease out, previous slide slides away first
Titles slide and fade in with a delay
Arrow keys switch slides, optional autoplay
Optional mouse tilt that shifts and rotates the image based on cursor position
Screens 800px and below move the nav to the top and shrink titles
editableByProps: Slides, images, titles, title colors and visible image area
Background, heading, nav colors and position, fonts and title size
Animation durations, eases, tilt, autoplay and keyboard control

needsCodeEdit.where: top-[38vh] class on the heading h2

fixed: Root is a full-screen h-screen section with hidden overflow
Listens to window mousemove when tilt is on and window keydown when keyboard is on, removed on unmount
Mirrored half is the same image flipped, so images should be roughly symmetric subjects

options.look: Image and its mirror sit side by side and slide in from the side
options.useWhen: A wide landing hero showcasing portrait subjects with a title across the middle

options.look: Image and its mirror stack top to bottom and slide in from below
options.useWhen: A hero for tall subjects or reflection-style imagery where a stacked symmetry fits
